arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. After the hard start, settle to shaft power near sustainable_shaft_power_w (about 150-160 W; pod CP 152 W, may be 10-25 pct off). Spend the pod reserve evenly; keep w_bal_pod_frac above about 0.3 until 2 km to go, then lift gradually; final sprint (finish cue) at about 400 m to go if reserve allows. Watch for incidents: drag jump (weed/rudder) = push_local minus push_along falls while pod power steady; pod drift = boat power / shaft power ratio shifts while GPS speed steady; radio messages (course change -> set_race_distance and tell). Compare same-direction legs with legs().

arguments.description: Local push minus fitted current along heading: falls when drag rises (weed, rudder) or pod reads high

arguments.name: eff_ratio
arguments.description: Boat-model power over pod shaft power: shifts on pod drift or extra drag

arguments.reason: check the paddler settled after the hard start (shaft power vs sustainable)

boat power / pod power ratio moved from 0.64: pod drift or drag change

text: no cue: hard start is expected; plan, incident metrics and watches set, waking at 2.4 min to check they settle.

arguments.text: Settle now. Ease to steady race effort, long smooth strokes.

2.4 min: hard start took pod reserve to 34 pct (shaft ~220 W for 2 min vs CP 152). Cued ease at 2.4 min. Target shaft ~150-155 W now. Baseline eff_ratio ~0.64-0.68, drag_anom ~ +0.15 on leg 1 (push_local 0.36 vs push_along 0.22).

arguments.reason: check effect of ease cue on shaft power and reserve

text: Cued ease: hard start drained pod reserve to 34 pct with 9.5 km left; target ~150-155 W shaft.

arguments.text: Good. Hold this rhythm, no harder yet. Save it for later.

4.5 min: shaft 165 W, pod reserve 21 pct and falling (model empties in ~700 m). Paddler says 7/10, could go harder: maybe CP underestimated, maybe overconfident. Cued hold. Test: if reserve hits ~5 pct and speed at same rate does not fade (fade_pct, cp_implied_w), raise CP via set_critical_power; if fade appears, ease to ~150 W.

arguments.reason: check reserve trend and fade after hold cue; CP evidence

text: Cued hold at ~165 W: paddler feels strong but model reserve is low; watching for CP evidence.

arguments.text: Ease just a touch. Smooth and steady, long race ahead.

6.2 min: pod reserve 14 pct at 161 W shaft, fade -1.2 pct at same rate (mild). Cued small ease toward CP (~150 W) to stop the drain; reassess CP from cp_implied_w and fade. Turn into leg 2 (current against, push_along ~ -0.28).

arguments.reason: check shaft power near 150 W after small ease, reserve stable, back-leg numbers

text: Cued a small ease: pod reserve 14 pct at 161 W with mild fade; aim at CP ~150 W to stop the drain.

arguments.message: speed at same rate fading more than 3 pct: real fatigue?
reserve model below 5 pct for 75 s: does the paddler still hold power without fade? CP test

arguments.text: 7.6 min: ease cue barely moved them (162->158 W). Paddler now 6/10 feeling good, could go harder, while model reserve 9 pct pod / 6 pct boat; fade only -0.5 pct; eff_ratio steady 0.62-0.66. Evidence CP may be underestimated. Running the test: no cue, let them hold ~160 W; watches fade_drop (fade<-3) and model_empty (reserve<5 pct 75 s). If model empty and no fade -> raise CP (try cp_shaft ~165-170).

arguments.reason: CP test check: shaft power, fade, reserve model after ~4 more min near 160 W

text: no cue: paddler feels 6/10 near model-empty with no fade; testing whether CP is underestimated with fade and empty-reserve watches.

arguments.text: Not yet. Hold this exact pace, your push comes later.
8.0 min: paddler said feeling great, going harder (unprompted). Model reserve 8 pct pod at 160 W. Cued hold to block a surge until CP test answers (model empty + no fade = raise CP).

text: Cued hold: paddler wants to surge with model reserve at 8 pct; wait for the CP test before allowing more.

arguments.text: Ease slightly. Relaxed and steady, this is your race pace.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Reserve spent by the hard start (model ~0 at 9 min); CP 152 W shaft looks right (fade grew to -2 pct while pod power slid 164->156 W, eff_ratio steady ~0.64, so not drag or current). Paddler is overconfident (says feeling great): do not let them surge. Hold shaft ~148-152 W (boat ~97-99 W) through the middle; no pushes. Final sprint (finish cue) at ~400 m to go, maybe a lift at ~1000 m if pod reserve has rebuilt above ~25 pct. Watch for incidents: drag jump (drag_anom falls with pod power steady -> clear_rudder if weed), pod drift (eff_ratio shifts with GPS speed steady), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell).

9.2 min: CP test answered: model empty and fade -2.1 pct with pod power sliding to 156 W; eff_ratio 0.64 unchanged so the fade is the paddler, not drag/current. Keep CP as calibrated. Cued ease toward ~150 W.

arguments.reason: check shaft power ~150 W, fade not worsening, through the turn into leg 3

text: Cued ease to ~150 W: model reserve empty and fade growing to -2 pct, so calibrated CP stands; paddler is overconfident.

arguments.message: pod power well below CP: blow-up, incident, or pod drift?
paddler surging above 170 W with reserve near empty

arguments.text: 12.2 min: holding 155 W shaft, fade steady ~-2 pct, pod reserve 2 pct, boat reserve 0. Not forced down yet. If they keep 155 W past pod-empty without fade worsening, CP may be ~155; if forced down, CP confirmed. Watches power_drop (<138 W) and surge (>170 W) added.

arguments.reason: after pod reserve hits 0: is the paddler forced down (CP right) or still ~155 W with no fade (CP higher)? compare leg 1 and leg 3 with legs()
